director.text: Hello Riya, main Asha, tumhari AI teacher. Aaj perimeter seekhenge—cricket ground ke boundary-run jaisa. Tumhe cricket mein kya pasand hai: batting ya bowling?
Achha, Riya—cricket pasand hai! Socho boundary ke chaaron taraf ek round daudna: tum kis cheez ki total length nikalogi? Golu ko baad mein sikhaogi.
Riya, perimeter boundary ki total length hoti hai. Is rectangle ki sides 50 m aur 30 m hain; chaaron sides jodne ka tareeka batao.
Ek udaharan dekho, kadam se kadam. Diya hai: 3, 50 m aur 30 m. Pehle: 2 × (50 + 30) = 2 × 80 = 160 m. Ab tak samajh aaya?
Rectangle ka ek round perimeter hai: 2 × (50 + 30) = 160 m. Khaali jagah bharo: 3 × 160 = ___ m.
Theek hai, Riya. Ab 160 m ki 3 lengths jodo: 3 times 160 kitna hoga? Blank mein ___ m bharo.
Riya, 3 ko 160 se multiply karna hai. 160 ko teen baar jodne ka step likho. Khaali jagah bharo: 3 × 160 = ___ m.
Example: 2 bags mein 140 balls each hain; total nikalne ke liye 2 ko 140 se multiply karoge. Ab 3 × 160 ka try karo.
Riya, 160 ko teen baar jodo: pehle 160 plus 160, phir usme ek aur 160. Khaali jagah bharo: 3 × 160 = ___ m.
Woh wala: jawab 480; 3 × 160 = 480 m. Is calculation mein 160 ko teen baar jodna tha; sirf ek chhota step chhoot gaya. Ek triangle ki sides 5 cm, 6 cm aur 9 cm hain. Iska perimeter kya hai?

director.text: Theek hai, Riya—tum rukna chahti ho, maine suna. Abhi continue, pause, ya aaj yahin end karna—kya choose karogi?
